KL = KL(original ‖ edited) of the next-token distribution on the 40 general-knowledge prompts. ΔPPL on WikiText-2 test. Two general prompts sit on a knife edge in the original model (`Big Ben is a clock tower in`: P(London)=0.382 vs P(the)=0.365; `Sushi is a traditional dish from`: P(Japan)=0.223 vs P(the)=0.207), so 'general acc Δ' of −2.5 pp is usually one of these flipping; KL is the more sensitive measure.
